lines.t: Yeah…
We talk power, not just talk.
They got a form of godliness, no power in the veins,
Church talk “freedom” while they livin’ in chains.
False hell doctrine, fake days on they lips,
Don’t want the Surgeon with the scalpel in the midst.
Not just saved from the second death,
Heart on the table, every secret in His test.
If the Blood can’t heal my history now,
Then you cancelled out the Cross, better lay that down.
Grew up in the pain, in the rage, in the smoke,
Church said “you’re good” after one quick quote.
Never touched trauma, never searched the root,
Just “smile on Sunday, wear your Sunday suit.”
Taught me fear, talkin’ ‘bout flames,
But never showed the Doctor rewiring my brain.
So I numbed my hurt with the same old sin,
Wondered why the cage kept pullin’ me in.They said “One day, when you finally die,
You’ll be free from the struggle that you fight inside.”
So I white‑knuckled lust, tried to choke my pride,
But the more I fought flesh, the more flesh survived.
They never talked cause, only talked effect,
Never asked why I’m broken, only told me “correct.”
So the roots stayed live in the soil of my soul,
While the fruit looked saved but it all smelled cold.
They got a form of godliness, no power in the veins,
Church talk “freedom” while they livin’ in chains.
False hell doctrine, fake days on they lips,
Don’t want the Surgeon with the scalpel in the midst.
Not just saved from the second death,
Heart on the table, every secret in His test.
If the Blood can’t heal my history now,
Then you cancelled out the Cross, better lay that down.
Told me “holidays holy,” lights, trees, sales,
But never kept the days where His story unveils.
Talk “grace” all month, swipe cards, stack debt,
But the poor at the door, they ignore, no help.
Put fear in my chest with they hellfire script,
But changed what He said with they own fine print.
Said His Blood just moves you past the grave,
Not that He breaks chains now and makes men brave.So I came to YahuShua like a thug in withdrawal,
“Either heal me in the present or it’s not worth it at all.
If You can’t touch the nights where I learned how to hide,
If You can’t heal the child, how You saving my life?”
He said “Open up the record, let Me read every line,
I’m not just your Lawyer, I’m the Doctor of time.
I don’t do quick deals where you stay in the cell,
I don’t do quick deals where you stay in the cell,
I cut to the root where the coping dwells.”
Every vow, every scar, every dark made law,
I bring into the light, I rewrite what you saw.
They got a form of godliness, no power in the veins,
Church talk “freedom” while they livin’ in chains.
False hell doctrine, fake days on they lips,
Don’t want the Surgeon with the scalpel in the midst.
Not just saved from the second death,
Heart on the table, every secret in His test.
If the Blood can’t heal my history now,
Then you cancelled out the Cross, better lay that down.
He walked me back through the scenes I buried,
Where the curse felt normal and the load got heavy.
Showed how a boy in the room with the slammin’ doors
Made unspoken vows just to feel secure.
“Never be weak, never cry, never trust,
Only power, only money, only pride, only lust.”
Those words grew roots, wrapped tight ‘round my spine,
Turned into the chains I kept callin’ “my grind.”He said, “I was there when your heart learned fear,
I was there when your mind wrote lies in your ear.
I’m here now to cross out every word in My red,
To write ‘SON’ like a banner over all that’s been said.”
So I laid out my scripts, every page, every scene,
He washed ‘em in Blood till the ink ran clean.
Not just a court case, not just a deal,
This the kind of salvation where the soul learns heal.
All my old scripts written in sin,
Crossed out, crossed out, new life begins.
Every dark vow, every secret code,
Crossed out, crossed out, He breaks that load.
Not just later when my heart stops beat,
He’s healing my now, from the head to the feet.
Opened up rooms I was scared to explore,
Now I walk with the Doctor through every locked door.
They got a form of godliness, no power in the veins,
Church talk “freedom” while they livin’ in chains.
False hell doctrine, fake days on they lips,
Don’t want the Surgeon with the scalpel in the midst.
Not just saved from the second death,
Heart on the table, every secret in His test.
If the Blood can’t heal my history now,
Then you cancelled out the Cross, better lay that down.
Now when sin come knockin’ I don’t just swing,
Like I’m fightin’ alone with these worn‑out swings.
I ask “What’s the wound that this bait tryna feed?
What pain in my story makes me want this thing?”
He shines His light, I confess, He deals,
Not just with the action but the place I feel.
So the root gets cut and the branch dries out,
This that real thug gospel with the pure urgency.
